karty.priklad: Dw i'n hoffi ymweld ag arddangosfa neu amgueddfa.
karty.priklad_cs: I like visiting an exhibition or a museum.
karty.mnemo: ar + dangos (to show) + -fa (place): the place where things are shown – today the red dragon itself is on display.

extra.pozn: arddangos = to exhibit (L12); sentence from p. 126, adapted

karty.priklad: Ces i freuddwyd ryfedd neithiwr.
karty.priklad_cs: I had a strange dream last night (breuddwyd → [f]reuddwyd after ces i; rhyfedd → [r]yfedd after the feminine breuddwyd).
karty.mnemo: In your dream you BRAVE (BREUDD-) a river of red lava.

extra.pozn: breuddwydio = to dream (L17); own example

sever.priklad_cs: I had a strange dream last night (breuddwyd → [f]reuddwyd after ges i; rhyfedd → [r]yfedd after the feminine breuddwyd).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Taflodd y plant garreg i'r llyn.
karty.priklad_cs: The children threw a stone into the lake (carreg → [g]arreg as the object after the verb form).
karty.mnemo: A CARRIAGE (CARR-eg) piled high with red-hot stones from the bonfire.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Mae enw Wil ar y garreg fedd.
karty.priklad_cs: Wil's name is on the gravestone (carreg → [g]arreg after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: carreg (stone) + bedd (grave): a wreath of red poppies leaning on the gravestone.

extra.pozn: bedd → fedd: the describing word after the feminine carreg takes soft mutation; in the plural cerrig beddau there is no mutation; own sentence based on the story on p. 128

karty.priklad: Mae gwau'n grefft boblogaidd.
karty.priklad_cs: Knitting is a popular craft (crefft → [g]refft after 'n; poblogaidd → [b]oblogaidd after the feminine crefft).
karty.mnemo: From English craft: the blacksmith's craft – sparks flying off a red-hot horseshoe.

extra.pozn: celf a chrefft = arts and crafts (p. 126, crefft → [ch]refft after a); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r grŵp gwerin talentog Grawnwin Surion wedi cael gwahoddiad i ganu yn Efrog Newydd.
karty.priklad_cs: The talented folk group Sour Grapes have been invited to sing in New York (canu → [g]anu after i).
karty.mnemo: grawn (grain) + gwin (wine): a grain of wine – one plump red grape.

extra.pozn: grawnwin = collective plural (grapes), grawnwinen = one grape; sentence from p. 122, shortened

karty.priklad: Mae hi mewn hwyliau da heddiw.
karty.priklad_cs: She's in a good mood today.
karty.mnemo: HWYL ~ WHEEL: fun on a Ferris wheel lit up red. hwyl is also a sail, and Hwyl! = Bye!

extra.pozn: mewn hwyliau da / drwg = in a good / bad mood (plural); Hwyl fawr! = Goodbye (mawr → [f]awr after the feminine hwyl); homonym hwyl = sail (also feminine, pl. hwyliau); sentence from p. 119

karty.priklad: Mae Mrs Llinos Smith o'r Llywodraeth wedi ffonio.
karty.priklad_cs: Mrs Llinos Smith from the Government has phoned.
karty.mnemo: llyw (helm, steering wheel): the government holds the helm of the state – and walks in on a red carpet.

extra.pozn: ll does not mutate after the article in the feminine (y llywodraeth); sentence from the dialogue on p. 120

karty.priklad: Gofynnodd Ann i'r forwyn fynd â'r neges at Wil.
karty.priklad_cs: Ann asked the maid to take the message to Wil (morwyn → [f]orwyn after 'r, feminine; mynd → [f]ynd after i'r forwyn in the pattern gofyn i rywun wneud).
karty.mnemo: The maid in a red apron scrubs till her hands glow red: MORE WINdows (MOR-WYN) to clean!

extra.pozn: Y Forwyn Fair = the Virgin Mary; own sentence based on the story on p. 128

karty.priklad: Mae carreg fedd Wil yn y fynwent yn Llangynwyd.
karty.priklad_cs: Wil's gravestone is in the graveyard in Llangynwyd (mynwent → [f]ynwent after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: MONUMENTS (MYNWENT) in the graveyard, with red candles flickering among them.

extra.pozn: sentence from the story Y Ferch o Gefn Ydfa (p. 128)

karty.priklad: Fy mai i oedd e.
karty.priklad_cs: It was my fault (bai → [m]ai after fy, nasal mutation).
karty.mnemo: "BYE (BAI)!" shouts the one to blame – and runs off across thin ice.

extra.pozn: beio = to blame; ar fai = to blame, at fault; own example

sever.priklad_cs: It was my fault (bai → [m]ai after fy, nasal mutation).

karty.cs_upresneni: memory as an ability, not a recollection
karty.priklad: Mae cof da gyda chi os dych chi'n cofio pen-blwydd pawb.
karty.priklad_cs: You've got a good memory if you remember everyone's birthday.
karty.mnemo: COF ~ COFFER: your memory is a strong box frozen deep inside a glacier. cofio = to remember.

extra.pozn: er cof am = in memory of; mae'r cof yn fyw = the memory lives on (p. 128); sentence based on the definition on p. 127

sever.priklad: Mae gynnoch chi gof da os dach chi'n cofio pen-blwydd pawb.
sever.priklad_cs: You've got a good memory if you remember everyone's birthday (cof → [g]of after gynnoch chi).
sever.pozn: north: gynnoch chi instead of gyda chi (L6), dach instead of dych (L11)

karty.priklad: Doedd ei gyfoeth e ddim yn golygu dim byd iddi hi.
karty.priklad_cs: His wealth meant nothing to her (cyfoeth → [g]yfoeth after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: A CAVE OF (CYF-OETH) treasure: wealth piled high in an ice cave.

extra.pozn: cyfoethog = rich; the book's definition: llawer o arian (p. 127); own sentence based on the story on p. 128

sever.priklad: Doedd ei gyfoeth o ddim yn golygu dim byd iddi hi.
sever.priklad_cs: His wealth meant nothing to her (cyfoeth → [g]yfoeth after ei = his).

karty.priklad: Eisteddwch yn y cysgod am ychydig.
karty.priklad_cs: Sit in the shade for a bit.
karty.mnemo: In the shade (cysgod) you sleep (cysgu) well – cool and blue, like a snowman out of the sun.

extra.pozn: cysgodi = to shade, to shelter; own example based on the dialogue on p. 120

karty.priklad: Sut mae adeiladu'r theatr wedi helpu economi Llanaber?
karty.priklad_cs: How has building the theatre helped Llanaber's economy?
karty.mnemo: From English economy – frozen solid, with prices on ice.

extra.pozn: economaidd = economic (L20); sentence from p. 123; gender: the coursebook has m, current usage is often f (economi gylchol, yr economi werdd) – to check

karty.priklad: Mae fy chwaer i'n disgwyl gefeilliaid.
karty.priklad_cs: My sister is expecting twins.
karty.mnemo: Mum GAVE ELLa (GEF-ELL) a twin brother – in matching blue snowsuits.

extra.pozn: grammatically masculine even for a girl; gefeillio = to twin (towns, L17); own example

karty.priklad: Mae snorclo'n weithgaredd poblogaidd yng Nghymru.
karty.priklad_cs: Snorkelling is a popular activity in Wales (gweithgaredd → [w]eithgaredd after 'n).
karty.mnemo: gweithgar (hard-working, from gwaith = work) + -edd: what keeps a hard-working polar bear busy – fishing through the ice all day.

extra.pozn: gweithgar = hard-working (L13); pattern Mae e'n weithgaredd diddorol (p. 119), own sentence

karty.priklad: Dw i'n gwau sgarff o wlân.
karty.priklad_cs: I'm knitting a scarf out of wool (gwlân → [w]lân after o).
karty.mnemo: gWLÂN sounds a bit like WOOLLEN: a blue woollen hat against the hailstones.

extra.pozn: gwlanen = flannel; related in meaning: gwau = to knit; own example

karty.priklad: Ble mae'r nodiadau ar gyfer yr hyfforddiant y prynhawn 'ma?
karty.priklad_cs: Where are the notes for this afternoon's training?
karty.mnemo: ffordd (way, road): the trainer shows you the way – up the ski lift and down the slope.

extra.pozn: hyfforddi = to train; hyfforddwr = trainer, coach; sentence from the dialogue on p. 120

karty.priklad: Roedd y noson gyntaf yn llwyddiant mawr.
karty.priklad_cs: The first night was a great success (ll does not mutate after yn).
karty.mnemo: llwyddo (to succeed) + -iant: success – planting your flag on top of an iceberg.

extra.pozn: based on p. 124 (noson lwyddiannus), own sentence

karty.priklad: Mae hi wedi canu ar lwyfan yr Eisteddfod.
karty.priklad_cs: She has sung on the Eisteddfod stage (llwyfan → [l]wyfan after ar).
karty.mnemo: The stage is the back of a VAN (llwy-FAN) at a frosty outdoor gig.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Wnes i ddim gwneud hynny o bwrpas!
karty.priklad_cs: I didn't do that on purpose! (pwrpas → [b]wrpas after o)
karty.mnemo: From English purpose: did you fall through the frozen pond on purpose?

extra.pozn: o bwrpas = on purpose, deliberately; pwrpasol = purposeful, suitable; own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n deall dy safbwynt di, ond dw i ddim yn cytuno.
karty.priklad_cs: I understand your point of view, but I don't agree.
karty.mnemo: saf- (sefyll = to stand) + pwynt (point): the point you stand on – a cold, blue mountain peak.

extra.pozn: own example
